Then compare wait times on the next few changes against the three-day baseline. Optional additions: none. The reply explicitly advises against funding squads/chapters, Jira Align, quarterly workshops or other tooling. Unmet needs: none identified, though the agent says it has not checked the tracker or review settings.

labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me: the six changes' timings, the sole reviewer, the lead's absence, and that two other engineers are qualified and authorized to approve. I have not looked at your tracker or review settings.
